reviewSamples.author: Photo of Evens Dorelus
reviewSamples.text: If you are in the Orlando/ Kissimmee area looking for a luxury Car detailer, hit up Melvin auto Detailing. Easy, smooth, professional and great experience. Paid attention to details and he was very reasonable with his pricing. He was meticulous! Highly recommend him

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Maribel Serrano
reviewSamples.text: If you want someone who cares about the little details, this is it! Second car done by Melvin and he never disappoints. Left my car looking better than when I purchased it. He's efficient, profesional, friendly and all around a great guy, you can tell he loves what he does, and that makes all the difference.

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Jay Rose Nuevo Año
reviewSamples.text: Honorable discharge veteran here police candidate for new York. I have integrity. This man is the truth he’s a legend. Fast sharp and professional with the detailing and he’s mobile he comes to you from anywhere call him now !

reviewSamples.text: Great service and pricing. I recommend Melvin 100% he will make sure to get your car right💯 …

reviewSamples.author: Photo of G G
reviewSamples.text:
Hi everyone!
If you’re looking for a committed, hardworking detailing professional, Melvin is the one. He takes pride in his work and even gives helpful suggestions for your car’s future detailing needs without trying to push extra services on you.
He’s not like a “car dealer” trying to upsell everything, and to me, that says a lot about his honesty and professionalism. It’s honorable to see someone truly care about the quality of what they do. Highly recommended!
